patterns: APPSC asks one-liners: Greek name Hydaspes = Jhelum; entry via Khyber Pass; year of invasion (326/327 BC).
Other PSCs recur on Porus defeated at Jhelum, Dhanananda/Nanda contemporary, first Persian ruler (key: Darius I), causes of Alexander's success.
Trap: Chandragupta did not defeat Alexander (A-R items); Alexander left India 325 BC.
App goes deeper (Herodotus tribute, Ashokan-Persian pillar features, Malloi, Deimachus) than PYQ depth and mixes in Kalinga/Vedic battles.
